summary.intent: Group related pending todos (#5, #8, #9 — shared-folder SDK ownership, redundant seeding cleanup, and itemName encryption) onto a single GSD phase, then drive it through full planning including research, design decisions, and pattern mapping.
summary.outcome: Phase 48 ('SDK self-bootstrap regression fix and shared-folder/metadata consolidation') was created, branched, and fully planned through the pattern-mapping stage; ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, RESEARCH.md, CONTEXT.md, VALIDATION.md, and PATTERNS.md were all committed; the planner subagent was spawned and running at session end.

repo: web-e2e only auto-triggers on push to main (via ci-e2e.yml paths-filter → workflow_call), never on PRs — this is the gap that let PR #498's regression land undetected.

web-e2e.yml is directly workflow_dispatch-enabled with `ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}`, so `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh workflow run web-e2e.yml --ref <branch>` runs the identical job against a feature branch pre-merge; direct dispatch resolves repo secrets without a secrets:inherit parent.
The server is zero-knowledge and cannot re-encrypt existing plaintext share.itemName rows; legacy data must be handled via lazy client backfill on next access, not a server-side UPDATE migration.
sharedFolderTree must be a sibling Map keyed by shareId (not an extension of folderTree) because shared folders carry a distinct SharedWriteContext and can collide on ipnsName.

TypeORM migration command for this repo: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run`; REQ-4 migration must be additive (nullable bytea column, no data UPDATE) to satisfy the zero-knowledge constraint.
Pre-commit hook runs markdownlint (skips .planning/) and prettier; .planning/ markdown docs are normalized on commit but never blocked.

CRDT-IPNS-inbox research todo (#2) would subsume the itemName plaintext leak (REQ-4) if it ever ships, because all inbox content would be ECIES-wrapped to the recipient — cross-linked in ROADMAP but explicitly deferred as long-horizon.
gh pr create triggers a bot release commit; any subsequent push to the branch must fetch+rebase before pushing to avoid a non-fast-forward conflict.

code.finding: loadFolder does an unconditional folderTree.set() — root cause of #498 regression; fix is a sequenceNumber guard (if existing.sequenceNumber >= resolved, keep existing) before this line.
ensureFolderLoaded short-circuit — must be kept intact when applying the REQ-1 reconcile guard to avoid re-regressing #498.
DFS child-check in ensureFolderLoaded — must be kept intact alongside the REQ-1 fix.
Already returns {publishedChildren, newSequenceNumber} via publishWithCas — REQ-3 client methods can delegate directly to this, no new publish logic needed.
folder:updated event definition — exact analog for the new sharedFolder:updated event that REQ-3's event-fed projection will consume.
Write-back logic that becomes an event-fed projection in REQ-3; withConflictRetry is dropped here because CAS moves into the SDK client.
ECIES wrap points for itemName encryption (REQ-4); mirrors the existing encryptedKey flow.
Template for the REQ-4 migration — clone this structure for the nullable item_name_encrypted bytea column; analog field is encryptedIpnsKey at share.entity.ts:72.

workflow: When a pending todo's premise depends on a recent PR 'proving out in staging', check CI before treating it as ready — #498 was the unproven PR and was actively regressing main at session start.
For security todos with an open M-severity finding, do not defer them to a long-horizon research track even if that track would subsume them; cross-link and decide the finding on its own merits.

The GSD pattern-mapper step (spawned before the planner) produces analog file-by-file line references that let the planner skip re-deriving conventions — worth the extra subagent cost on phases touching multiple subsystems.

For unattended AFK execution runs, pre-decide the signing fallback policy (try signed; if 1Password hangs, fall back to unsigned and flag for re-sign) and the hard-stop condition (red e2e = park, don't open PR) to avoid the pipeline wedging.

friction: Stream idle timeout mid-response during the initial parallel-reader fan-out ('API Error: Stream idle timeout - partial response received'), requiring the user to redirect to the GSD phase workflow instead.

web-e2e.yml's main-only auto-trigger (the structural gap) caused PR #498 to regress main undetected and inverted the premise of todo #9 — discovered only by investigating the failing e2e run mid-session.
1Password SSH signing is a latent wedge risk for unattended AFK commit chains; required a pre-emptive fallback policy decision before the user left.
